every_position_composed.reason: Both sites use the exact same camera choreography and framing from frames 1 through 9, keeping the 3D machinery in view to the right of the left-aligned text card.

explains_the_project.reason: Both sites use identical 3D factory metaphors—such as the containment press in frame 3, drawer vault in frame 5, and caliper in frame 6—to illustrate Straitjacket's workflow.

craft_of_the_3d.reason: In frames 1 through 9, the second site's lighter slate floor makes cast shadows and the dark metal frames of the machinery clearly visible and grounded, whereas they blend into the pitch-dark floor on the first site.

type_and_layout.reason: Both sites share identical typography, UI hierarchy, and left-docked panel layouts across all frames from 1 to 9.

overall.reason: While both sites share the exact same layout, text, and 3D models, the second site's brighter, higher-contrast floor material grounds the dark machinery with visible shadows and makes the 3D visualization much easier to read.
